selected_tools.name: inspect_artifact
selected_tools.title: Inspect Artifact
selected_tools.description: Inspect an active archive or application package, including Node.js SEA carriers, in one call. By default returns the complete content-addressed artifact graph once, as the typed nested inventory Evidence, with root and integrity observations, integrity contradictions, hypotheses, unexplored branches, limitations, and next probes inline. For PCK and large containers prefer detail summary: it retains the complete inspection and returns its derived summary view; read exact paths, batch occurrence/content IDs and selected fields with inspect_analysis_view using parent_evidence_id. This changes delivery, not inventory coverage. Read-only DMG mounting is used automatically on supported macOS hosts. Integrity mismatches fail by default; record-and-continue keeps mismatches explicitly untrusted. It does not extract files; use extract_artifact to materialize regular contents of supported formats. DMG extraction is unavailable; use a caller-managed read-only mount on macOS to access its files.

Omitted or complete detail returns complete metadata inventories with original coverage. Select detail: "summary" on the first call for complete identity, PE/CLI, classification with its evidence, module/MVID, assembly, frameworks, returned-collection counts, coverage/issues and limitations. It retains complete Evidence and returns a distinct linked inspect_analysis_view summary. Page original references/resources/attributes with view kind managed and normalized_result.parent_evidence_id. Counts cover producer-returned rows; partial, unavailable or malformed metadata remains explicit and tokens remain build-local.

selected_tools.name: open_binary
selected_tools.title: Open Binary
selected_tools.description: Open a local executable, application bundle, archive, JavaScript, source map, plist, or analysis database after validation. format=dos-com explicitly interprets 1..65280 headerless bytes as a DOS COM analysis image. format=raw-binary interprets headerless bytes with a required architecture and entry_point; file offset 0 maps at that address. Omission preserves header-based detection. provider_id selects one deep provider or deterministic auto selection; the binding remains stable until close or an explicit switch, with no failure fallback. Reopening the same target and profile retains its active database and metadata edits. An optional analysis snapshot is imported atomically and must match the binary identity, concrete provider, and canonical analysis profile exactly; importing into a session with metadata mutations requires closing and reopening it first. Call close_binary when the investigation is finished.

path.description: Absolute local filesystem path for the analysis target; relative paths are rejected.

format.description: Explicit interpretation: dos-com or raw-binary (headerless), or gamecube-dol (GameCube/Wii DOL, never auto-detected). Omission preserves header-based detection.

architecture.description: Caller-supplied CPU family. Required with format=raw-binary; rejected otherwise. format=gamecube-dol takes powerpc from the header, so it must be omitted.

entry_point.description: Caller-supplied load and entry address (0xhex). File offset 0 is mapped here. Required with format=raw-binary; rejected otherwise. Optional with format=gamecube-dol; must equal the DOL header entry.

provider_id.description: Exact deep-analysis provider ID, or automatic selection when omitted.

snapshot_path.description: Absolute local filesystem path for the analysis snapshot; relative paths are rejected.
